- Gallery: the photo viewer has a new zoom. The picture is read once at a size that stays sharp when zoomed (the long edge 2048 px) and drawn by the viewer's own code: pinch zoom, pan when zoomed, double tap or the zoom button to zoom in at the point touched and back, up to the zoom level set in the settings (2.5x at first, never less than 4x). At the whole picture the pager still turns the page. A selected photo that stayed black is drawn again by this code; the earlier zoom code and the Fossify library are gone.
